name: aspect_pass2_structured
description: Structured aspect extraction with a fixed taxonomy. Use after Pass 1 to enforce consistent labels. Edit `extra.categories` to your hand-picked taxonomy before running.
prompt:
Extract aspects from this text.

You MUST use ONLY these categories (exact spelling):
{extra.categories}

If something doesn't fit any category, use "Other".

For each aspect return:
- "category": one of the allowed categories
- "sentiment": "positive", "negative", or "neutral"
- "quote": short supporting quote

Return JSON: {"aspects": [ ... ]}

TEXT:
{target}
